ats_platforms.notes: Live public RSS feeds verified on 10 November 2026. Root Platform returned 3 items; Footasylum returned 80; TeamViewer returned the default first 100 and a separate offset=100&per_page=2 request returned later vacancies. The feed exposes global GUIDs, HTML-encoded descriptions, advert URLs, publication dates, remote status and namespaced location/department/role data. Custom TeamViewer careers domain works. The total number of TeamViewer vacancies was not established.

tester_instructions.objective: Investigate actual career pages using browser network inspection, page source/scripts/embedded data, endpoint reproduction and live validation. Do not merely ask an AI to list vacancies.
per_employer: Official career URL and redirect chain
Listing endpoint, method, headers and payload
Individual detail retrieval and full description
Canonical vacancy URL and vacancy-specific application URL
Authentication, bot protection, rate limits or restrictions
tester_instructions.acceptance: HTTP 200 alone is not success. Demonstrate meaningful listing and detail retrieval and preserve the exact vacancy/application destination.
scope_limits: Research and proof of concept only; do not modify application code.
Do not implement adapters until retrieval methods are demonstrated and documented.
Do not bypass authentication, CAPTCHA, bot protection or other access controls.
Test at least three employer boards per ATS where possible; do not generalise from one employer.
